description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {3}.
Tawnos triggers, copying the Junk Diver spell.
Both Junk Divers enter the battlefield.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Junk Diver, adding {2}.
Junk Diver dies, returning any other artifact card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Junk Diver token, adding {2}.
The Junk Diver token dies, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
